shared_elements: row of repeated vertical strokes/elements forming a band
justification: Both surfaces show schematic animals in profile above or beside a horizontal band composed of repeated vertical strokes, but in A that band is the crew of a large boat with upturned spiral prows — a motif entirely absent from B, which instead stacks predatory quadrupeds, birds and arcaded figures in vertical registers on a pillar. The correspondences (an animal in profile, a row of repeated marks) are of the most generic kind that any tradition could produce independently, and the dominant subjects — a manned ship versus a hierarchy of beasts and birds — have nothing in common.
